incidents.name: Ambient CrocSwapDex surplus-collateral accounting
incidents.notes: Flash-loaned WETH deposited as CrocSwapDex native surplus collateral, then a tick-by-tick walk of the ETH/USDC curve with a narrow mint-and-harvest let the attacker disburse more surplus than was deposited, exposing a surplus-collateral accounting flaw in the dex.

sources.ref: onchain review: CrocSwapDex 0xAaAaAAAaA24eEeb8d57D431224f73832bC34f688 created 2023-05-29 by 0x8023901399d7927181892642a0913b06fda30847, unrelated to attack sender; the dex declares only CrocKnockoutCross and emits no EIP-1967 Upgraded event, so code changes were recovered by binary-searching eth_getStorageAt over proxyPaths_ (address[65536] at slot 1, callpath k at slot 1+k) between the creation and incident blocks: callpaths 0/2/3/4/7 installed 2023-05-29, callpath 1 reinstalled 2024-02-26T23:12:47Z (block 19314934, WarmPath 0xa9dd587ad17aed82cac5596b16dcc9defec885cb) and callpath 5 2024-02-26T23:33:35Z (block 19315038); callpaths 6/8-12/128-133 unset. The exploit drives callpaths 1, 2 and 3. Age measured from the latest install rather than deployment; ~67.85 ETH extracted

incidents.documentedLastChange: 2024-02-26T23:33:35Z (block 19315038): last CrocSwapDex callpath sidecar install before the incident; the WarmPath sidecar carrying surplus-collateral accounting (callpath 1) was reinstalled 21 minutes earlier at 2024-02-26T23:12:47Z, block 19314934
